hotels.title: Serene Legian Beachside Hideaway near Double Six Beach with Outdoor Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Escape to the serene beauty of Bali's Legian area, just moments from the lively and iconic Double Six Beach, offering the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Spend your days lounging beneath lush tropical trees, swimming in the dazzling pool or strolling down to the beach to watch the stunning sunset over Bali's most renowned coastline. Savour a romantic poolside dining experience or explore authentic Balinese cuisine by visiting nearby vibrant markets and eateries in Seminyak. For pure rejuvination, visit Hideaway Spa, where tranquil treatments like couples massages and soothing jacuzzis await.

hotels.title: Pullman Bali Beachfront Resort with Rooftop Infinity Pool, Relaxing Spa & Three Bars
hotels.description: Relax in the pinnacle of paradise at this five-star beachfront haven perfectly poised between Bali's famous Kuta and Legian beaches. While the local area is dotted with vibrant bars and trendy restaurants, this luxurious hotel feels quiet and exclusive thanks to a ring of Balinese tropical gardens, hiding three pools, a breathtaking spa and an onsite restaurant. There's plenty to discover beyond the hotel - including some of Bali's best day clubs and boutique shopping - but this luxury oasis has plenty to entice you to stay and simply lounge within the hotel's grounds. Treat yourself to a global dining affair at Montage or opt for something a little more relaxed with a drink and small bite at one of three stunning bars.

hotels.title: Stylish Bali Escape near Legian Beach with Spa & Outdoor Pool
hotels.description: Soak up the laidback Bali lifestyle at ibis Styles Bali Legian, just a leisurely stroll from Legian Beach and surrounded by bustling markets, lively cafes and the vibrant nightlife of Kuta and Seminyak. After a exploring colourful streets or surfing the waves, retreat to the hotel for a dip in the pool, complete with a kids' pool, sun loungers and a bar. For total relaxation, head to Chill Out SPA and indulge in a Balinese massage, or sip a cool drink at the poolside bar, meanwhile Colours Cafe is on hand with both Western favourites and Asian delights.
